portInfo.description: Autoridad del Puerto de Ponce documents cruise operations at piers 4, 5, and 6 on the south coast, with anchorage-and-tender assignments on some sailings. Confirm alongside vs tender on your daily programme before planning ashore time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Ponce historic centre — Plaza Las Delicias — ~120 min.
Parque de Bombas firehouse museum — central Ponce — ~60 min.
Museo de Arte de Ponce — longer call with taxi — ~150 min.
La Guancha boardwalk — seafood lunch stop — ~90 min.
Coffee plantation / south-coast coach — long call only.
thingsToDo.shortCall: ≥4 h. One central Ponce stop (Plaza Las Delicias area) with ≥90 min tender/transport buffer if assigned anchorage.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ponce is not San Juan — keep port codes and excursion pickup points labelled Ponce on your documents.

gettingThere.publicTransport: Historic centre. Allow a taxi or organised shore excursion from the municipal piers — confirm pier assignment and whether your ship is alongside or tendered before you leave the terminal area.
